messages:
Iris (partnerships): Quick sync: PolarCloud (HW) + TitanAI (SI) joint GTM preflight. Need confirmation on: hero variant, partner badge legal phrasing, SI activation runbook, staging preview URLs, and press embargo time. Proposed rehearsal: Thu 09:00 PT.
Ben (marketing): I can own the hero & toggles. Requesting svg logos + 1-line quotes from PolarCloud and TitanAI by Tue COB. I'll build two hero variants: with-quote and neutral fallback.
Kaito (cloud-ops): I'll provision two preview tenants and ephemeral DNS. Plan to post preview URLs by Wed AM. Will also ensure eu-west failover is in test mode.
Yara (legal): Reminder: logo usage requires signed marketplace asset addendum. Shared link: https://drive.redwood/legal/marketplace-addendum.md. If not signed by Tue COB, hero will use neutral assets.
Sam (eng): Infra status: tenant provisioning, OAuth flow, and billing event ingest are complete on staging. Small smoke script attached: https://git.redwood/marketplace/rehearsal/smoke.sh. Please avoid heavy token runs during rehearsal.
MayaS (solutions): SI runbook v0 uploaded: steps for SSO, credential handoff, sample data seed, and a failover validation. I need a 15m screenshare block during rehearsal to validate SSO with TitanAI.
Iris (partnerships): Cool. @Kaito please confirm preview URLs and @Ben coordinate logos/quotes. Also decide on embargo timing. Suggested: page goes live 08:45 PT, press embargo lifts 09:00 PT.
Ben (marketing): That timing works. We'll have landing go live at 08:45, then partner quotes roll at 09:00. If legal flags delays we'll do 08:45 neutral launch and add partners later.
Yara (legal): I'll chase signatures today. If PolarCloud requests changes, expect a 24h delay; fallback hero required.
Kaito (cloud-ops): Preview URLs I'll post: https://preview.marketplace.redwood/polarcloud and /titanai by Wed 08:30 PT. Also scheduling canary deploy Thu 06:30 PT.
Sam (eng): I'll run the smoke script during rehearsal and monitor meter events + tenant isolation. Posting a short rollback checklist to the runbook.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: Thu 06:30 PT -> 07:00 PT. (reaction :rocket:)
Iris (partnerships): Draft run-of-show for Thu 09:00 PT:
- 09:00 - 09:05 goals + roles (Iris)
- 09:05 - 09:20 SI activation & SSO screenshare (MayaS/TitanAI)
- 09:20 - 09:30 Provision & smoke test (Sam/Kaito)
- 09:30 - 09:40 Hero + asset QA (Ben)
- 09:40 - 09:50 Press embargo simulate & takedown flow (Yara)
Can people confirm availability?
Ben (marketing): Confirmed. I'll have both hero variants ready and a checklist for responsive breakpoints.
Kaito (cloud-ops): Confirmed. Will post preview URLs Wed AM and monitor quotas during rehearsal.
Yara (legal): Confirmed. I'll run embargo leak simulation and takedown steps.
MayaS (solutions): Confirmed. Will bring SI runbook and a short demo tenant.
Sam (eng): Confirmed. Running the smoke script and standing by on call.
Iris (partnerships): Action items from thread:
- partner logos + 1-line quotes -> owner: Ben / due Tue COB
- signed marketplace addendum -> owner: Yara / due Tue COB
- preview tenants + ephemeral DNS -> owner: Kaito / due Wed AM
- SI runbook + screenshare slot -> owner: MayaS / due Wed EOD
- smoke test + rollback checklist -> owner: Sam / due Wed EOD
If blockers appear, drop them here or DM me. :white_check_mark:
